title: Juicy Crispy Brazilian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and crispy Brazilian dish featuring passion fruit pulp, cooked to perfection in a claypot tagine, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This herbal and aromatic recipe is a twist on traditional Brazilian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Place the chicken thighs in the claypot tagine and brush the oil mixture evenly over both sides of the chicken.
Spoon the passion fruit pulp over the chicken thighs.
Cover the claypot tagine with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the chicken is crispy and golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as rice or roasted vegetables.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
